questions.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence “Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy.” You can make comments, cite examples, or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 150 words but no more than 200 words.
questions.correctAnswer:
Nowadays more and more people take delight in offering help to the needy. Their willingness to contribute reflects a growing recognition that a caring society depends on practical support as well as goodwill.

Helping others can address immediate difficulties and create lasting connections. A volunteer who teaches an older neighbor to use a hospital appointment system provides more than technical knowledge: the service makes healthcare easier to access and reduces anxiety. Similarly, donating suitable books to children can expand their learning opportunities. Effective assistance, however, requires attention to what recipients actually need. Asking questions and respecting their choices are better than assuming that every gift will be useful. Reliable help also matters more than a brief action performed only for public recognition.

Communities can encourage participation by explaining specific needs and organizing manageable volunteer tasks. Individuals should offer time or resources according to their abilities and keep their promises. When kindness is combined with respect and consistency, helping the needy benefits both those receiving support and those who learn to take responsibility for others.
